tech.trend: Trading above the whole moving-average stack, on a rising 200-day; fresh golden-cross
tech.summary: The price closed 4.07 above a rising 20-day (4.00), a rising 50-day (3.94) and a rising 200-day (3.87). Momentum is firm: RSI(14) is ~61 and the daily ATR near 0.06 (~1.4%) points to an orderly tape. MACD (12·26·9) is positive and rising (+0.04 / +0.03 / +0.01). The 50-day crossed above the 200-day 23 sessions ago — a fresh golden-cross, a momentum-regime change rather than noise inside an intact trend. Over the last year it has ranged 3.47–4.18; the last close sits 3% below that high and 17% above that low.
tech.bull: A daily close back above 4.15 would clear the nearest resistance and open the 4.40 zone.
tech.bear: A close below 4.00 would break the nearest support and open the 3.65 zone.
